question: Why did sales of MC6001LT stop in Western province from 23 October 2026?
story: 7 + I1 MC6001LT stops selling in Western from 23 October 2026 because the Western depots are empty
notes: Expected answer: no MC6001LT sold in Western since 23 Oct; the Colombo and Negombo depots have had zero stock since the end of 22 Oct; the Galle hub still holds stock; the last transfer to those depots was on 23 Sep.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.invoiced_quantity), 0) FROM ${fact_sales_stock_daily} f JOIN ${dim_location} l ON f.location_id = l.location_id WHERE f.product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND l.province = 'Western' AND f.activity_date >= DATE'2026-10-23') AS units_invoiced_since_23_oct, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.invoiced_quantity) / 30, 1) FROM ${fact_sales_stock_daily} f JOIN ${dim_location} l ON f.location_id = l.location_id WHERE f.product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND l.province = 'Western' AND f.activity_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-09-23' AND DATE'2026-10-22') AS avg_daily_units_before, (SELECT SUM(f.stock_quantity) FROM ${fact_sales_stock_daily} f JOIN ${dim_location} l ON f.location_id = l.location_id WHERE f.product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND l.province = 'Western' AND f.activity_date = DATE'2026-10-22') AS western_depot_stock_22_oct, (SELECT SUM(stock_quantity) FROM ${fact_stock_daily} WHERE product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND location_id = '2010-0090' AND snapshot_date = DATE'2026-10-22') AS hub_stock_22_oct, (SELECT MAX(m.posting_date) FROM ${fact_stock_movements} m JOIN ${dim_location} l ON m.location_id = l.location_id WHERE m.product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND m.movement_type = '315' AND l.province = 'Western') AS last_transfer_to_western_depots

question: How much MC6001LT stock did the Western depots have in October 2026?
notes: Stock is a level. "In October" = stock on the last day of October in the data, not the sum over the days.
ground_truth_sql: WITH last_day AS ( SELECT MAX(activity_date) AS stock_date FROM ${fact_sales_stock_daily} WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE'2026-10-01' AND DATE'2026-10-31' ) SELECT ld.stock_date, SUM(f.stock_quantity) AS depot_stock FROM ${fact_sales_stock_daily} f JOIN ${dim_location} l ON f.location_id = l.location_id JOIN last_day ld ON f.activity_date = ld.stock_date WHERE f.product_id = 'MC6001LT' AND l.province = 'Western' GROUP BY ld.stock_date
